row.body:
Hi Brittany! Quick heads-up for the Sea Grape posts: from now on my photo license asks for a credit in the caption of every social media post that uses one of my photos, written as "Photo: Gabi Santos @gabisantos.photo". MLS, print and anything you only email don't need it.

Thanks!
Gabi
